title: Chirang
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Chirang is a district in the Bodoland Territorial Region, in western Assam, with its headquarters at Kajalgaon.

Geography

Chirang lies between the Brahmaputra plain and the Bhutan foothills, with the Aie and Champamati rivers flowing through it, and parts of Manas National Park in its north.

Life

Agriculture, tea and forest produce are the main livelihoods, and the district's Bodo, Assamese, Bengali, Rajbongshi and other communities celebrate Bihu, Bathou and other festivals.
